name: Easy Apply Queue
tagline: Sits down for one focused hour of LinkedIn applications and never repeats a listing
description: Job hunting falls apart in two ways: the open-ended session that eats an entire evening, and the slow realisation that you have already applied to the same role twice. This gives the search a fixed sixty-minute slot and works through a stored backlog of postings, striking each one off the list as it goes.
author: HaseebMir91
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
